response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS rate FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_rates) AS relative_rate FROM media_rates

assumptions.assumption: Each media type is identified by MediaTypeId; two media types with the same name therefore appear as separate rows.
